method: Current national CH*AUTOSENSE owner scope + current AMAG public charging tariff; conditional eligible-brand tariff stored separately
policy: Current CH*AUTOSENSE owner scope only; every EVSE must identify as an AMAG Charging Station. Current AMAG public tariff: CHF 0.56/kWh for other vehicles; CHF 0.28/kWh is retained only as a conditional eligible-brand/app tariff, not used as an unconditional direct price.
